ios.desc:
HearTomo is an app that works with Apple Health to perform 1/f fluctuation slope, Lorenz plot, and emotion analysis from ECG data from Apple Watch.

1/f Fluctuation Slope Value
The heartbeat interval RRI data is converted to power spectral density PSD and the 1/f fluctuation slope value is calculated. You can see the value change over time in a graph: day, week, month, 6 months, and 1 year.

Lorenz Plot
One of the time domain indicators of autonomic nerve activity, RRI(n) is the interval between the nth heartbeat and the heartbeat before it. The value of RRI(n) is plotted on the x-axis and the value of RRI(n+1) on the y-axis.

Order-made Emotion Analysis
The accumulated data of the user is learned and updated daily to estimate emotions that suit the individual. The activity status of the sympathetic and parasympathetic nerves is classified into four states: "Both nerves are high", "Only sympathetic nerves are high", "Only parasympathetic nerves are high", and "Both nerves are low". Emotions are estimated as "inner voice".

HearTomo's basic technology
HearTomo development is based on  the heart rate data analysis system patent 6430729 in collaboration with ZMP and Mr. Osaka Motohisa (graduate of the Department of Mathematics, Faculty of Science, University of Tokyo and the Department of Medicine, Faculty of Medicine, Nippon Medical School, currently Professor Emeritus, Nippon Veterinary and Life Science University).
Mr. Osaka Motohisa conducted heart rate fluctuation analysis using his own calculation formula and an algorithm for spectral analysis of heart rate variability developed by Professor Ronald Berger from Johns Hopkins University Hospital.

To improve the accuracy of the analysis, let's capture a clean heart rate waveform.
Fix your arm on a table or your knee, and keep your fingers still for 30 seconds. After scrolling down to see the measurement results and tapping 'Done,' perform another 30-second measurement.
A total of 4 repetitions, requiring 2 minutes of data, is necessary, and compared to other apps' 30-second measurements, HearTomo offers 4 times higher accuracy.
Try to perform 4 consecutive measurements without leaving too much time between them.

Website: https://heartomo.com/?lang=en

quotes.text:
Hey Hacker News Community!

We are thrilled to introduce our latest development: an innovative iOS application that reads ECG data and provides real-time feedback on your emotions and heart health.

Key Features:

> Emotion Detection: 
Analyze your ECG data to understand your emotional state.

> Heart Health Monitoring: 
Get insights into your heart health based on your ECG readings.

> User-Friendly Interface: 
Designed with simplicity and ease-of-use in mind, making it accessible for everyone.

> Real-Time Feedback: 
Immediate analysis and feedback to keep you informed and proactive about your health.

Our app leverages advanced algorithms and machine learning to provide accurate and meaningful insights. Whether you're an athlete looking to optimize performance, or someone keen to monitor their heart health and emotional wellbeing, our app is designed to provide valuable feedback.

> Why It Matters: 
Understanding the connection between our physical and emotional health is more crucial than ever. Our app aims to bridge that gap by offering a tool that not only monitors your heart but also provides a deeper understanding of your emotional state.

> Join the Discussion: 
We'd love to hear your thoughts, feedback, and suggestions! Whether you're a developer interested in the tech behind it, or someone passionate about health and wellbeing, join us in this journey to make health monitoring more intuitive and accessible.
